title: PSMutPred predicts how missense variants alter protein phase separation
summary: PSMutPred is a machine-learning approach trained on missense variants that alter phase separation propensity. It performed robustly in predicting such variants, was supported by in vitro experiments, and was applied to over 522,000 ClinVar missense variants to help interpret variants of uncertain significance in intrinsically disordered regions.
ai_technology: PSMutPred machine-learning model for missense effects on phase separation

evidence.tested: In vitro experiments on predicted phase-separation effects; application to over 522,000 ClinVar variants.
evidence.unknown: Limited experimental detail in the abstract; clinical interpretation not validated; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: PSMutPred predicted the effect of each missense variant on phase separation.
